يسلنطع (form IIIq)
# يَسْلَنْطِعُ (yaslanṭiʕu) /jas.lan.tˤi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# يُسْلَنْطَعُ (yuslanṭaʕu) /jus.lan.tˤa.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# يَسْلَنْطِعَ (yaslanṭiʕa) /jas.lan.tˤi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْل
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
